commit.description: Exact available Git commit, not a mutable branch label.

capsule.description: Deterministic localfirst-source-capsule/v1 document with exact UTF-8 file bytes and modes.

qualification.description: Source comparison, fresh restore and actual declared-check results, bound to a replay command.

failure_cases: Tampered capsule bytes, sizes or hashes are refused.
Traversal, symlink, private-path and non-UTF-8 source inputs are refused.
An occupied restoration destination is not overlaid.
Changed implementation bytes invalidate the manifest revision.
Altered qualification gates or replay-command bindings are refused.
Failed real commands cannot produce a passing qualification.
assets.job: Transfer and safely restore an explicitly selected public UTF-8 source artifact from an exact Git commit, retaining fingerprints, modes and qualification evidence.
assets.title: Committed source capsule

limitations: built means current manifest and code bytes validate; it is not qualification or production acceptance.
proven requires a qualifying immutable report, capsule, pinned implementation, and a successful recorded replay command in the same verified RAPP frame.
reused requires different public repository identities with different commits and trees; copies, path aliases, repeated frames, and model or reviewer metadata do not establish transfer.
No asset is automatically promoted to shared-default, core, or production. Permission labels are declarations from the common contract, not granted authority.
The registry does not execute manifest checks, generated prompts, replay commands, or network requests.
Unsigned RAPP receipts establish integrity and lineage, not authenticated human authorship, trusted time, correctness in every context, demonstrated user demand, or legal priority.
Search scores are deterministic discovery heuristics, not measured demand or evidence of successful reuse. Verify a saved projection against source and evidence before relying on its status.
